Hi Ameet,

I saw Lollypop's opening for a Product Designer and wanted to apply, especially given your focus on crafting meaningful experiences through end-to-end research and design.

During my time as a UI/UX Designer at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings directly back into user flows and interface usability. I also built reusable design systems in my current role at Ascent Business Solutions that cut turnaround time for digital and print collateral.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates structured B2B UX problem-solving and research for accurate email verification workflows: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

Since this role is open in Mumbai and Hyderabad, I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate. Would you be open to a quick look at that case study?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
